shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi
sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md
sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md
pwd
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git log -5 --oneline --decorate
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git diff --check
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "Correct config hooks spec status" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
